# Carbon-Monroe-Pike Drug & Alcohol Commission (CMPDA)

> > CMPDA is a tri-county Single County Authority providing drug and alcohol treatment, prevention, recovery support, and overdose prevention services for Carbon, Monroe, and Pike counties in Pennsylvania.

Established in 1985 as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, CMPDA coordinates comprehensive substance use disorder services including outpatient treatment, medication-assisted treatment (MAT), DUI programs, naloxone distribution, and community prevention initiatives. The organization serves as the Single County Authority (SCA) for three Pennsylvania counties, connecting residents to licensed treatment providers like PATH and Pyramid Healthcare.

## Key Topics

- Carbon County, Monroe County, Pike County
- Single County Authority (SCA)
- Naloxone/Narcan overdose reversal

## Treatment & Recovery Services

- [Services Overview](https://www.cmpda.cog.pa.us/services): Comprehensive prevention, treatment, DUI, and case management services
- [Outpatient Drug & Alcohol Treatment](https://www.cmpda.cog.pa.us/outpatient-treatment): PA-licensed outpatient counseling services including PATH and Pyramid
- [Medication Assisted Treatment (MAT)](https://www.cmpda.cog.pa.us/medication-assisted-treatment): MAT program info: Suboxone, Vivitrol, Methadone for opioid treatment
- [Funding Eligibility](https://www.cmpda.cog.pa.us/eligibility): Treatment funding criteria for uninsured/underinsured county residents
- [DUI Program](https://www.cmpda.cog.pa.us/dui-program): PA Highway Safety DUI evaluation and education for Carbon County

## Overdose Prevention & Harm Reduction

- [Naloxone Information](https://www.cmpda.cog.pa.us/Naloxone-Info): Narcan/Naloxone info for opioid overdose reversal in Monroe & Pike counties
- [Prevention Programs](https://www.cmpda.cog.pa.us/prevention): School & community prevention programs in Carbon, Monroe, Pike counties
